text:
Leah - PMM: Uploaded a pared-down launch blog draft to Drive. Need a fast 24h pass: hero headline, bench note, legal quick-check, and webinar RSVP + routing.
Jon - Content: Draft link: https://drive.google.com/redwood-launch-spring26. Outline: problem -> serving unpredictability, our serving approach, small benchmark, CTA to webinar. Tentative headline: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower inference spend."
Tara - Design: Good. I want the hero to be a stacked cost bar + tiny latency sparkline. Send CSV and I'll mock two SVG variants for reuse in the deck.
Ibrahim - Growth: Webinar slot proposals: Fri 8am PT (APAC-friendly) or Tue 4pm PT (EMEA overlap). UTMs proposal: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_spring26&utm_content=webinar_cta
Elen - Legal: Headline is fine but avoid an absolute % claim without method. If you include a number: "in our tests, we saw up to 68% lower per-token spend vs baseline" + perf doc footnote. Also mark any placeholder quote as "beta customer".
Jon - Content: Swapped headline to include bench phrasing per Elen: "In our tests, Redwood lowered per-token spend by as much as 68% vs baseline." Footnote: https://internal.redwood/perf/2026-spring-launch
Mika - Ops: Provisional HubSpot form created: form_id=hs_launch_spring_04. I added hidden UTM fields. Routing rule: if interest_area == "dedicated" -> assign to Team_Dedicated, else -> inbound_pool. I'll lock field IDs after Diego confirms mapping.
reminder-bot: Tentative calendar event: "Redwood Launch Webinar — Tue 2026-04-21 16:00 PT". Zoom: https://zoom.example/launch-spring26 (provisional).
Leah - PMM: Plan: Jon finalize the blog and publish checklist, Tara posts hero SVGs in #design-review by EOD, Elen do a quick legal sign by 3pm, Ibrahim seeds UTMs and calendar invite, Mika finalizes HubSpot hidden fields and routing overnight. Ping me if you need me to adjudicate. :sparkles:
